text: Yes, tree-cover loss was detected on the property after 2020. In 2025, a loss event of 13.5 hectares (3.91% of the asset) was observed, meeting the corroboration rule: 98% of the affected area was confirmed as forest in the 2020 JRC baseline. No loss was detected in the 2024 data. The asset had 227.1 hectares of forest cover in 2020 (65.7% of its area).
